notes.why_now: change_event shows ceilings were applied to three of five campaigns on 2026-09-04 16:56 (GOOGLE_ADS_WEB_CLIENT, access@greenmarketingfl.com) from an empty old_resource. These two were missed. They are the only remaining uncapped Maximize Clicks campaigns in the account.
notes.measured_effect_of_the_existing_ceilings: Cost per valid click across the five fell from $46.66 (2026-08-14..2026-09-03, uncapped) to $25.93 (2026-09-05..2026-09-09, capped). Daily spend fell from $382.15 to $20.74. The capped window is 5 settled days and 4 valid clicks, which is directionally consistent with the ceiling binding but far too short to call the effect established.
notes.tension_with_the_spend_goal: This lowers, not raises, the ceiling on spend. Under the stated priority order qualified-lead economics outranks spend utilization, so this is the correct trade. It is stated explicitly rather than buried.
notes.not_a_forecast: No lead, cost or ranking outcome is promised. These are bounds on price per click, not predictions of volume.
